Casa review: digital legacy verdict

By the Afterkeep research team · Reviewed on 15 Oct 2026

Verdict: A leading multisig self-custody service with inheritance included in every plan, covering bitcoin, ETH and stablecoins. Best for: Bitcoin holders who want self-custody plus a guided inheritance plan.

Key facts

  • Category: Crypto inheritance
  • Pricing: From $250/yr (Standard); Premium $2,100/yr; Private Client $7,500/yr (USD). Check current pricing.
  • Best for: Bitcoin holders who want self-custody plus a guided inheritance plan.
  • Multisig removes the single point of failure
  • Inheritance included at no extra cost; recipients only need an email

Official site ↗ Legacy feature docs ↗

What are the pros and cons of Casa?

Pros

  • Multisig removes the single point of failure
  • Inheritance included at no extra cost; recipients only need an email
  • Six-month verification period after a claim, so the owner can cancel a false claim

Cons

  • Ongoing membership cost
  • Heirs still need some setup and guidance
